content.subject: Modern issuer processing and payment operations
content.draft_text:
Hi Chermaine,

I'm Zamp from Zamp Technologies. I'm reaching out because the complexity that comes with expanding payment operations may be an area we could help with.

I read your post about legacy payments, especially your point on modern issuer processing. I imagine keeping payment records aligned across systems can become increasingly time-consuming.

We build bots that reconcile payment data across systems and flag anomalies, reducing manual reconciliation effort.

Curious if this is something your finance team is thinking about right now? Happy to connect for a quick chat.

Best,
Zamp
